notes: transparent PETG; two 150x70x285 mm bag pockets split by a 2 mm divider, each open as a 70x285 mm doorway through its right (+X) wall, with a 6.5 mm (~1/4 in) tubing exit hole per pocket low in the left (-X) wall (bottom 6.5 mm above the floor); closed top (the 2 mm ceiling closes solid over the channel, whose top sits one wall thickness below the box top), with a rod hang channel (rod diameter plus clearance over its secure length, flared wide at the +X mouth downward-only (the mouth floor dropping clear to the resting depth, level with the pocket floor) for easy insertion and ramping back to the secure width over the outer half of the run) cut into the faces of the front wall/divider/back wall: a back-edge horizontal run that drops at center into an all-straight rest pocket (a 45 deg ramp down from the secure run, a flat floor, and a vertical back wall — no arcs, so it prints clean on the -X face), for one 1/8 in stainless rod through both bags' top loops, slid in from the +X back; the rod ends extend 6 mm past each outer wall into a boss whose outer surface is the channel cross-section grown by one wall thickness (a uniform 2 mm shell hugging the channel, open at the +X mouth) with a 2 mm plug past each tip capturing the rod along Y; outer envelope 154x162x289 mm including the rod-end bosses
